character: large male jaguar, spotted coat, condescending lazy predator
props: whole carcass as big as the jaguar hanging from a low branch over the water, in every frame; capybara pushing a wooden cart, always in motion
motion_rule: jaguar crosses to a new spot every window, never speaks from one place; camera always moving, shot size changes every window; capybara large at the lens, a new way to reach the carcass every window
environment: open sandy riverbank at the jungle edge, bright midday sun, hard shadows

audio.delivery: lazy, condescending, low male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: po-zhir-NEY, pri-DYOT-sa, a-HO-tit-sa, MAR-ke-te — the stress is HO in the hunting word, never a-ho-TIT-sa
audio.pacing: even pace, words fit each window with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: claws on bark, rope creaking, water splash, cart wheel in mud

timeline.a: the whole carcass swings from a low branch over the water; jaguar runs the branch from its far end to the carcass; capybara pushes her cart below
jaguar hooks a claw in the carcass, swings it like a punchbag at the capybara; she ducks, wheel stuck in mud
jaguar walks the branch to the lens, tail sweeping the carcass; capybara stacks logs from the cart under it
jaguar drops off the branch onto a root; capybara climbs her log stack, stretching for the carcass
jaguar shoulders the carcass, it swings and kicks the stack from under her; capybara sits down hard in the mud
jaguar slides off the root onto the sand; capybara rams the cart into the branch and the carcass swings
jaguar paces the sand by the water toward the lens; capybara ropes the branch and hauls, the carcass rides higher
jaguar rears and pins the swinging carcass with both paws; capybara at the lens, rope going slack, misses
jaguar swats the carcass into a full arc and it sweeps the capybara off her feet into the shallows; her cart rolls after her
capybara surfaces and drags the cart back under the carcass; jaguar drives her along the water to the lens, both crossing the frame
jaguar leaps back onto the branch and hangs off the carcass by all four paws, swinging over the water; capybara reaches from the cart and misses
jaguar lands in the shallows in a fan of spray, side to side across the frame; capybara backs the cart from the splash and tips it over
jaguar bursts at the lens and swerves past it, spotted flank filling the frame; the carcass still swings behind him, capybara chases her runaway cart
the carcass huge on the branch, jaguar's paw hooked in it; capybara huge at the lens pushing her empty cart right past the camera

must_appear: the hanging carcass on the branch in every window from 0.0; jaguar in a new spot every window; capybara at the lens reaching for it and missing every time
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, dim, moody, low key, neon, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, only his head moving, speaking from one spot, standing still under the carcass, a small piece of meat, meat lying on the ground, the carcass carried away, blood, gore, wound, English speech, foreign accent, Latin letters, any word after 6.3, extra limbs, more than two characters, character changing mid-shot
